chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin hai sagih a tawi vantungmite khat in hong pai-in kei kiangah, “Hih lai takah hong pai in, tui lianpi tungah tu-in a om a lian numei gilo in a thuak ding thukhenna kong musak ding hi.
Tua numei tawh leitung kumpite in a mawh uh a, leitungmite in ama nu leh pa mawhna leenggahzu a kham uh hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua lai takin amah in Kha Siangtho tawh keimah gam lakah hong paipih a, Pasian tungah paukhialhna min a dim, lutang sagih leh ki sawm a nei, sahang san tungah tu-a a om numei khat ka mu hi.

Tua numei in a san a eng puante silhin, kham tawh, suangmanpha tawh, kep suangmanpha tawh kizeemin, a khutah ama gitlohna gamtatna kihhuaina ahi muhdahhuai nate tawh a dim kham tawh a dim khamhai a tawi hi.
A taltang tungah, thu thukpi, “Leitungah a om Numei Gilote leh leitung Kihhuainate’ Nu Babilon Khuapi,” ci-in a min kigelh hi.
Tua numei in zong misiangthote’ sisan ahi zongin, Zeisu’ teci pangte’ sisan ahi zongin dawnin kham a, om ka mu hi. Kei in ka et ciangin lamdang ka sa mahmah hi.
Vantungmi in, “Bang hangin lamdang sa na hi hiam? Tua numei-a kipan lutang sagih leh ki sawm a nei tua numei tuan’na sahang’ thu thukpi kong gen ding hi.

Na muh sahang in a om ngei zo hi, tu-in om lo hi; kuamthuk sung pan a hong pusuakkhia ding a, kisiatna-ah a pai ding hi. Leitung pian’ cil-a kipan nuntakna laibu sungah a min kikhum lo leitungah a om mite in tua sahang a om ngei thu, tu-in a om loh thu, a omkik ding sahang ahihna thu a muh uh ciangin lamdang a sa ding uh hi.
Hih thu-ah pilna lungsim a om hi. Lutang sagih in tua numei tutna mual sagih ahi hi.
Kumpi sagih zong ahi hi. Nga a kia zo hi. Tu-in khat a om hi. A om lai khat a piang nai kei hi. A hong pian’ ciangin tomkha bek a kip ding hi.
A om ngei, tu-in a om lo sahang mah in zong giatna kumpi ahi tham loin sagihte lakah zong ahi hi. Amah in kisiatna-ah a pai ding hi.
Na muh ki sawm in gam a ngah nai lo kumpi sawm ahi uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in sahang tawh kumpi za aana nai khat sung a ngah uh hi.
Tuate in ngimna khat bek a nei uh a, amaute vangliatna leh aana sahang kiangah a pia uh hi.

Amaute in Tuuno tawh a kido uh ciangin Tuuno in amau a zo gawp ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in topate’ Topa, kumpite’ Kumpipa ahi hi. Kiteelkhia, kisamin, thuman mi ahi Topa tawh a omkhawm mite in zong a zo gawp ding uh hi,” ci-in kei kiangah hong gen hi.
Khat vei amah in, “Numei gilo tutna-a na muh tuite in mipawl, mihon, gam, kamte ahi uh hi.
Nangma muh ki sawm leh sahangte in tua numei gilo a muhdah khit uh ciangin amah belh ding suan ding nei lo suakin ama sa ne-in, amah a kat tum nadingin mei tawh a hal ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amau lungsim kibang uh ahih theih nading ahi zongin, Pasian’ thute a kicingsak dongin, amaute gam sahang tungah ap ding ahi zongin, amau lungkim ding ahi zongin Pasian in ngaihsutna a pia hi.
Na muh numei zong leitung kumpite a uk khuapi ahi hi,” ci-in ka kiangah hong gen hi.
